# Paired Scalar Declaration Provenance Proposal R206–R208

## Scope and Result

Propose only the four taxonomy-approved kind-only canonical leaves and11 explicit schema/data JSON-pointer changes below. No canonical file or directory was created; no frozen R204 JSON, production source, API, price, caller, test collection, launch row or runtime consumer was changed.

R208 executes an in-memory paired preview through Nx:4 original/proposed schema/data validations,11 exact pointer changes,4 cross-pair rejections,4 inverse matches and43 unchanged scalar vectors. The four original hashes match before/after and equal the frozen R204 values. This is proposed provenance validation, not canonical publication or runtime acceptance.

R206 failed before the controller because Nx exec added its own shell quotes around an already quoted loader. R207 reached the loader but the optional fast-json-patch package was unavailable. Neither is a semantic RED. No dependency was installed; R208 uses existing Immer patches/inverses and strict Ajv. Both failure logs remain retained separately.

The new fixture data ID requires the paired exact `properties.$id.const` and required-array entry at index10. The declaration already has an ID, so its paired const changes without changing the required-property set. There is no additional `$schema` data property, metadata object, provenance pointer or acceptance field.

A fresh authored-framework JSON scan found no existing occurrence of the proposed `semio.ui.retained.resident.scalar.` ID prefix. This is a source scan, not global package publication or URI registration.

Both statuses explicitly mean source declaration/oracle only and runtime unmounted. The data describes desired accounting/ownership laws, not implemented private brands or a completed reader consumer. The schema IDs likewise identify declaration/test schemas, not a published runtime wire version.

## Everything Else Is Frozen

The preview checks that the actual changed pointer set is exactly the table above and that the inverse patches recreate each entire original JSON value. Therefore all other pointers remain equal, including:

-43 scalar vectors,25/18 outcomes, all profiles and generic IEEE versus UI-profile distinction.
-91 receipt traces/2238 literal rows,14 construction prefixes, explicit dual-alias unlink and original before/after fault rules.
-Proposed decoder992/14/14, payload+8, reader+16, all construction/close grants and complete child suffix data.
-Original reader/page paths and SHA256s, canonical Actor word reference, mandatory scalar-only proposed callables and their unmounted status.
-`registeredTestProposal`, which still says not-mounted. Mounting source-only controllers later does not justify pretending a runtime consumer exists or silently rewriting those desired callables.

The existing mandatory scalar-only global caller limitation and withdrawn extra opaque consumer are documented in R205; these are design review findings, not hidden changes to the frozen declarations. A later whole-field grammar-owner proposal must be reviewed as its own semantic delta, never folded into this11-pointer provenance-only packet.

Original ticket files remain permanently byte-preserved. A future approved canonical source copy is a separate artifact with the exact paired changes, not a move/rename of the evidence or a rewrite of its old hashes. Its source tests must import only the canonical pairs and canonical child authorities, never ticket artifacts. The existing renderer route and all three named tests must produce actual nonzero collection/results; passWithNoTests exit0 is not acceptance.
